Royal Holloway International Undergraduate Scholarship 2027

Royal Holloway International Undergraduate Scholarship 2027

  • Fees and funding    
  • Scholarships    
  • Royal Holloway International Undergraduate Scholarship 2027
Degree Type Undergraduate Award Type Scholarship Fee Status Type International
Tuition fee reduction of £3,000 a year for international undergraduate students achieving BBB (or equivalent) at A-level.

Scholarships are awarded automatically to eligible students, you won't need to submit a separate application.

You can be applying to study for any of our undergraduate degrees. You'll receive £3,000 off your tuition fees for each year of study.

Am I eligible?

  • International fee status
  • Achieve BBB at A-level, International Baccalaureate at 30 overall or 5,5,5 in HLs or other equivalent grades
  • Offer to study an undergraduate degree starting in September 2027

How do I apply?

The scholarship is applied automatically to eligible students.

Please note, this information is for students joining us in 2027. If you're planning to join us in September 2026, find out more about our current Royal Holloway International Undergraduate Scholarship 2026.

Read our full terms and conditions.

Please note, these are our terms and conditions for 2026 entry and will be updated soon for 2027 entry.
